name: Volja
source:
Number Three of the Ten Great Nobles, he previously served under Hadasht as his most trusted lieutenant. His title was given to him by Hadasht as a compromise to help end the war which preceded Hadasht's reign. However, he was out of favour with Hadasht in the latter years of the reign because of his potentially treasonous actions.

[Spoiler] Volja was besotted with Hadasht's wife Aristea, who was a direct descendant of the first demon king and was fighting to reunify the realm in the midst of a devastating civil war. Volja's feelings were unrequited and he looked down on Hadasht as an upstart commoner, a feeling which was accelerated when Primtine's birth was a contributing factor to Aristea's premature death. After acquiring Karkel as his lackey, he eventually assassinated Hadasht after the king was weakened by another of Primtine's uncontrollable mana bursts. Together with Ardbelt, he is considered among the frontrunners for the vacant throne when Fabio is employed by Primtine.

In Primtine's route, he inadvertently confesses to being behind Hadasht's murder. Thanks to Fabio's scheme, he is separated from Karkel in the decisive battle and falls after a great battle in Primtine's presence. With his death, the death of Primtine's father and older brother are avenged. 

In the other routes, he is killed by the other nobles in some form or another. [/Spoiler]

Although his talent is undisputed, his arrogant and overbearing demeanour make him the most unpopular of the Ten Great Nobles.
